epics.title: Saved Searches and Favorites
epics.jtbd: When using the system frequently, I want to save my search queries and favorite materials, so that I can quickly access them later without repeating complex searches.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce average time to retrieve frequently used materials from >30s to <5s
requirements: R1: Enable authenticated users to save search queries and favorite materials
R2: Securely store and allow retrieval of these preferences

slices.title: Patch existing user profile to persist saved searches and favorites
slices.jtbd: When implementing saved searches for this epic, I want to patch the existing user profile logic, so that search preferences are stored without introducing new data models.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated user, When they save a search query or favorite a document, Then the system updates their profile's preferences field.
Given an authenticated user, When they fetch their preferences, Then the saved searches and favorites are returned correctly.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Database query volume for repeated searches
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce redundant complex search queries by 15%

epics.title: Search Auto-Suggestions
epics.jtbd: When typing a query in the search bar, I want to see real-time auto-suggestions, so that I can find materials faster and correct my input on the fly.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce search query abandonment rate by 20%
requirements: R1: Return real-time auto-suggestions when typing in the search bar
R2: Include typo correction in the returned suggestions

slices.title: Patch existing search UI to display auto-suggestions and typo corrections
slices.jtbd: When implementing auto-suggestions for this epic, I want to patch the existing search input component, so that users receive real-time feedback without needing a new UI slice.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search input field, When a user starts typing, Then the UI debounces the input and fetches suggestions from the existing search endpoint.
Given a returned list of suggestions or typo corrections, When received, Then the UI displays them immediately for user selection.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase click-through rate on search suggestions by 25%

requirements: R1: Support offline addition of materials
R2: Automatically push locally saved materials to the server upon reconnection

slices.title: Patch existing service worker to queue offline material creation
slices.jtbd: When implementing offline material sync for this epic, I want to patch the existing service worker logic, so that offline creations are queued and synced without building a new API contract.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an offline state, When a user creates or modifies a document, Then the application stores the action locally in IndexedDB.
Given a restored network connection, When the application detects it, Then the queued local changes are automatically pushed to the server.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce lost work due to network drops to 0%
